agreementsNote: Seat estimates use the five surplus-vote agreements the Central Elections Committee published in the Official Gazette on Oct 19, 2026 (Yalkut HaPirsumim 15045, p. 1098): Yashar–The Democrats, B'Yachad–Yisrael Beiteinu, Joint List–Ra'am, Likud–Religious Zionism, Shas–UTJ. A sixth pair of fringe lists is not modelled. Otzma Yehudit, Amcha Yisrael, the Reservists, Blue and White and Noam filed none. Verified against the gazette Oct 23.
